name: endpoint_not_found
description: Payload FlowTransport sends to the well-known token WLTOKEN_ENDPOINT_NOT_FOUND (UID(-1, 0)) when a packet arrives for an unknown endpoint: the unknown token, a UID as the root member (a 16-byte scalar inline in the root table). WLTOKEN_UNAUTHORIZED_ENDPOINT (UID(-1, 2)) carries the same payload.
